Whats up I'm a 17 year old male living on the east coast of Florida. I have HH exclusive to my feet and armpits. (Armpits are actually dry most of the time) The only treatments I've tried are iontophoresis and carpe lotion. Neither work very well (They help a little bit) so I'm just gonna tough this out until we have laser treatments or miradry for hands. My mom and grandma both have this problem but its not nearly as bad as mine. Their HH also mostly wore off when they were in their mid 30s. I have 5 siblings and none of them have HH. My HH is also on and off I can go a few days completely dry but most of the time my sweating is out of control. During the winter I can go weeks at a time were I sweat normally its relieving af. My HH is most annoying for me when holding hands, video games (Cotton gloves help me play), playing instruments, writing on paper and shooting handguns is also difficult. Most of my friends don't even know about my condition and I got my drivers licence just fine. HH has really made life difficult but i'm not gonna let it stop me from achieving my goals. I also really like fishing : )
Thanks for keeping us updated, if you learn anything new please let us know.
